evidence: ParseDocument now parses with fences, and re-parses without them only when parseDocument reports a fence still open at the end. With fences=false the fence branch is skipped and fence stays empty, so headings are never hidden.

fenceRun now returns no run for a backtick fence whose trailing text contains a backtick, which matches CommonMark. A tilde fence is still allowed a backtick in its info string, so the check correctly applies only when trimmed[0] is a backtick.

An odd number of stray or unmatched fence lines always leaves a fence open at the end and triggers the fallback. The new test covers the three stray forms: an open ```go, the inline ```x``` text, and an open ~~~.
